schema_description: Directory-level resolved bootstrap-CI metadata sidecar. Covers all per-cell evaluation.json files under results/h8-v2/**/ produced by scripts/evaluate_detections.py. Does NOT cover sibling threshold_sweep.json files (explicit metadata per registry) or run_pv.py outputs.
registry_commit_note: Sidecar written at repository HEAD e038bfe8 on 2026-04-20. Generated during the H8-v2 sweep on 2026-04-15.

invocation.command_shape: python scripts/evaluate_detections.py --detections <h8-v2 cell geojson> --buffers 20 30 40 50 --bootstrap 1000 --seed 42 --ground-truth <gold-standard v2 geojson> --bounds <standard 384 bounds>

per_cell_ci_count: 3 metrics (F1, precision, recall) x 4 buffers = 12 CIs per cell
notes: Hypothesis 8 v2 greedy and WBF cells. The greedy cells are organised by scale (4/8/16/32), plus-hp, canonical, pure-positive-canon at thresholds t1 through t5.
